view_frame: The primary view is TOP (XY plane), showing the planar layout of the handle. The world axes are X (width, horizontal in view), Y (depth, vertical in view), and Z (height, perpendicular to the view). The 'END SECTION' view shows the cross-section of the path, which is circular. The path lies in the XY plane, and the circular cross-section is oriented such that its plane is perpendicular to the path tangent at every point.

features.placement: The path consists of two straight segments and one semicircular arc. The arc is centered at (0, 30) with radius 20 mm, spanning from angle 0 to 180 degrees (counterclockwise). The right straight leg extends from (20, 30) to (20, 0). The left straight leg extends from (-20, 30) to (-20, 0). The entire path is lifted by the section radius (4 mm) so the bottom of the handle rests on Z=0.
features.evidence: Top view shows a U-shaped path. Text 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm' defines the geometry. 'END SECTION' shows a circle with 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The straight legs are tangent to the semicircular arc at (20, 30) and (-20, 30).
edit_rules: Changing the 'diameter' updates the section size and the Z-offset of the path.
Changing 'Bend centreline R20' updates the arc radius and the X-coordinates of the straight legs.
Changing 'straight legs 30 mm' updates the Y-length of the straight segments.
